admin.title: Administration

admin.users.name: Name

settings.adminOnly: The AI connection, budgets and price table are shared by everyone; only administrators can change them.
admin.market.intro: Every ticker and FX pair ever used accumulates daily prices, dividends and splits. Prices are stored unadjusted; total return is computed here and checked against the source.
admin.sources.intro: US statements come straight from the SEC's official XBRL data: every document is kept as fetched, every filed number accumulates, and restatements keep both values.
admin.sources.secContactHelp: The SEC requires an organisation name and an e-mail on every request; both are needed. They are only sent to the SEC, as a contact.
admin.sources.needContact: Set the SEC contact before fetching statement data.
admin.sources.synced: {ticker} {name}: {filings} new filings and {facts} new numbers, {total} in total.
admin.sources.unchanged: {ticker} {name}: no change at the SEC ({total} numbers).
admin.sources.noXbrl: This company has no XBRL financial data.
admin.sources.saved: Saved. Requests to the SEC will now carry “{contact}”.
theme.label: Theme
theme.help: Saved to your account and used on your other devices.
market.note.adjusted_mismatch: The total return computed here differs from the source's adjusted close and needs review. Common causes: the source applies a dividend in the wrong currency (e.g. declared in USD, traded in HKD) or misses a rights issue. The system computes total return itself from unadjusted prices and dividends.
market.note.source_usd_dividend: The source's adjusted close deducts dividends declared in USD as if they were HKD (about 7.8 times too little). The system checked each ex-date and reproduces the source's figures by repeating that mistake; its own total return uses the HKD dividend and is the correct figure.
market.note.no_source_adjusted: The source has no adjusted prices to check against.

filed.none.title: No statement data for {ticker} yet
filed.asFiledNote: This is the as-filed view: every number exactly as the company reported it to the SEC, with a link to the filing. When a later filing changes a period, the older number is marked “restated”. Standardised annual and quarterly statements (common line items, comparable) come in the next alpha.3 step.
filed.restatedHint: A later filing changed this period to another number; both are kept.
filed.filingPeriodHint: The fiscal year and period of the filing itself. Later filings repeat earlier periods as comparatives.
std.title: Standardised statements
std.subtitle: Amounts in {ccy} millions (except per share) · chart of accounts {ruleset} {version}
std.view.latest.hint: Each period from the most recent filing, so years are comparable
std.view.original.hint: Each period as the company first reported it
std.template.bank: This company is a bank or lender. The bank chart of accounts (net interest income, provisions …) comes in a later step; the general chart is used below, so items such as revenue and gross profit may not apply.
std.template.insurance: This company is an insurer. The insurance chart of accounts (premiums, claims, float …) comes in a later step; the general chart is used below, so some items do not apply.
std.legend: Select any number to see where it comes from. ƒ = computed by formula; Δ = quarter derived from year-to-date figures; R = restated in a later filing; S = adjusted for a stock split; — = not filed.
std.mark.restated: A later filing changed this number
std.change.restated: First reported as {original}; a later filing changed it to {latest}.
std.showing.original: Showing the number as first reported.
std.splits: Per-share figures and share counts are adjusted for stock splits so years compare: {list}.
std.splitAdjusted: Filed as {raw}; adjusted for stock splits after filing (×{factor} in total).
filed.none.noContact: An administrator has not set the SEC contact yet, so US statements cannot be fetched.
filed.none.noContactAdmin: Set the SEC contact under Admin → Data sources and statements; after that, statements are fetched automatically when anyone opens a US stock.
filed.none.notUs: {ticker} does not file with the SEC. Statement sources outside the US come in a later version.
filed.none.fetching: Fetching {ticker}'s statements from the SEC… the first time can take a few dozen seconds; they appear here when done.
filed.none.ready: US statements come straight from the SEC. Use the button below to fetch them.
filed.err.sec_not_filer: {ticker} does not file with the SEC.
filed.err.upstream: The SEC is not responding right now; try again later.
filed.err.sec_contact_missing: The SEC contact is not set.

admin.sources.dailyNone: Daily new-filing check: runs with the market-data update; not run yet.
std.mark.derived: Derived from year-to-date figures (no three-month figure filed, or the fourth quarter)
std.from.ttmSum: TTM = the last four quarters added: {quarters}
std.from.ttmPerShare: TTM per share = last fiscal year + year to date − same period last year (rule {rule}):
check.title: Data checks
check.intro: Every period is checked against check rules {version}; the letter under each column is its data quality: A all passed, B warnings, C errors.
check.yahoo: Cross-checked against Yahoo figures fetched {at} (unofficial, for reference only).
check.noYahoo: No second-source figures yet, so no cross-source check.
check.allPassed: Every check passed for the periods shown.
check.grade.B: B: warnings; usable, but take note
check.grade.C: C: errors; a valuation should not use these as they are
check.balance_total: Total assets = total liabilities and equity
check.balance_parts: Total assets = total liabilities + total equity
check.gross_profit: Gross profit = revenue − cost of revenue
check.net_income_split: Net income = shareholders' share + non-controlling interests
check.eps_diluted: Diluted EPS ≈ net income to shareholders ÷ diluted shares
check.cost_of_revenue_not_negative: Cost of revenue should not be negative
check.capex_not_negative: Capital expenditure (a payment) should not be negative
check.revenue_jump: Revenue differs from the previous period by over 20× (possibly a unit error)
check.total_assets_jump: Total assets differ from the previous period by over 20× (possibly a unit error)
check.quarters_add_up: Four quarters add up to the year
